registration_statement: Written and committed in its own commit before any Python-vs-Rust comparison of this component was executed. No Rust code for the component exists at registration. The commit is recorded in the report, not here.

reference_implementation.rule: the campaign refuses to score (REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED) if any reference file sha256 differs from sha256_at_registration; a changed reference requires a new contract version
reference_implementation.import: p2_framework.py is loaded by file path (it loads p2_impedance_reducer.py itself); p1_reducer.py is loaded by file path; the harness imports nothing else from these directories

environment.numpy: 2.4.4 (imported by p1_reducer.py, not used by p_bus_from_generator_input)
environment.stdlib: CPython 3.11 complex arithmetic (_Py_c_sum / _diff / _prod / _quot; int and float operands promoted to complex(x, 0.0); 'complex division by zero'), abs(complex) = hypot, cmath.rect (phi == 0 branch), math.radians, float(str) (underscores, inf / nan spellings), str.splitlines / split / strip, built-in sum starting at int 0 (no Neumaier compensation in 3.11), float pow via libm, format '.9g'

functions_or_entry_points: abep_subsystems::power::rf_match::{parse_touchstone, sol_error_terms, sol_correct, ladder_abcd, dissipated_fraction_matched, vi_power_and_impedance, cx, gamma_from_z, z_from_gamma, vswr, gamma_mag_from_powers, s_to_abcd, abcd_to_s, cascade, z_in, deembed_load, transfer_efficiency, correct_reflection, fixture_to_plane, line_peak_stress, p_bus_from_generator_input}
`power_eval` example (harness interface, shared with the other SC-WP-05 contracts)
rust_implementation.target_crate_note: the plan names abep-subsystems::power and abep-icp for SC-WP-05; the RF-network kernels go into abep-subsystems::power so that the NP-ICP crate's verified sources are not touched (its verification report v1 binds them)
rust_implementation.rust_commit: FILL at scoring time (recorded in the report build_provenance, not here)
rust_implementation.rule: the report records the sha256 of every provenance source; any later change is UNRECORDED_SOURCE_CHANGE until a scoring execution records it

governing_hashes.rule: no governed file is read by the scored functions

golden_vectors.source: registered_cases plus the randomized domain; Python outputs captured at scoring

encoding.passed_as_given: cx (v, what), vi_power_and_impedance (all four phasor arguments and the convention), sol_error_terms (standards), ladder_abcd (elements), parse_touchstone (text, n_ports; allow_spec_defaults False and source None when absent) and p_bus_from_generator_input (record) receive the JSON value unchanged: the reference validates it
encoding.converted: every other complex parameter given as a JSON [re, im] list is converted by the harness to complex(re, im) (sol_correct gamma_measured and the values of terms; dissipated_fraction_matched s11 / s21; gamma_from_z z; z_from_gamma g; s_to_abcd s11 / s12 / s21 / s22; correct_reflection m_raw / e00 / e11 / e10e01; z_in z_load; deembed_load z_input; transfer_efficiency z_load; fixture_to_plane v_p / i_p); an ABCD argument (abcd, abcd_fix, m1, m2) is a list of four [re, im] lists converted to a tuple of complex; a number is passed unchanged; real parameters (z0, gmag, p_fwd, p_ref, line_peak_stress arguments) are passed unchanged
encoding.$sol: standards built by the harness: for each actual gamma a (as complex), measured = e00 + e10e01 * a / (1 - e11 * a) + noise_i (Python complex arithmetic, the registered terms as complex), entries {'id': ids[i] or 'STD<i>', 'gamma_actual': [a.real, a.imag], 'gamma_measured': [m.real, m.imag], 'definition_source': 'registered synthetic standard'}

args.text:
# HZ S RI R 50
# GHZ S MA R 75
1 0.1 0.2

registered_cases.note: network data after the noise block

args.text:
# HZ S RI R 50
! only comments

registered_cases.note: Python float() accepts single underscores between digits
bool equal to 1 behaves as 1 in the reference
float n_ports: TypeError at the first data line in the reference
SHORT / OPEN / LOAD measured through the registered terms (measured values computed by the harness from the three-term model in Python complex arithmetic)
constant reading: singular or e10e01 = 0 (whichever the reference reaches)
any kind other than 'series' is taken as shunt by the reference
no convention check in the reference: rms factor

draw.rng: Python random.Random(master_seed * 1000 + k), k = 1..7 for R1..R7
draw.R1: n_ports choice(1, 2); unit choice(HZ, KHZ, MHZ, GHZ); format choice(RI, MA, DB); R choice(50, 75, 100) written as given; 1-12 points with increasing frequency (uniform steps); values uniform(-1, 1) (RI), magnitude uniform(0, 1) and angle uniform(-180, 180) (MA), dB uniform(-60, 0) and angle (DB); written with repr(); with probability 0.15 one defect (swap two frequencies, drop a value, add a non-numeric token)
draw.R2: true terms e00, e11 with |.| <= 0.2 / 0.3 and e10e01 of magnitude uniform(0.7, 1.0) and random phase; 3-6 standards with actual gammas of magnitude <= 1; measured through the model plus noise uniform(-1e-3, 1e-3) on each part with probability 0.5
draw.R3: terms as R2, gamma_measured magnitude uniform(0, 1), random phase
draw.R4: 1-5 elements, kind choice(series, shunt), Z_ohm re uniform(0, 5), im uniform(-500, 500)
draw.R5: s11, s21 with magnitudes uniform(0, 1) and random phases
draw.R6: V_raw, I_raw, k_V, k_I parts uniform(-10, 10) (k parts uniform(0.1, 200)), convention choice(peak, rms)
draw.R7: 60 calls each of gamma_from_z, z_from_gamma, vswr, gamma_mag_from_powers, s_to_abcd, abcd_to_s, transfer_efficiency and correct_reflection with magnitudes in the registered edge-case ranges (refusals included where the draw reaches them)

randomized_domain.domain_note: numerical parity domain only; dB values within [-300, 300] and angles within [-1e4, 1e4] degrees

campaign_seeds.applicable: true (input generation only; the component is deterministic)

rng_stream_roles.rule: A9.29 sec. 7 (RM-OQ-03): design / UQ sampling uses exact registered stream parity; TPMC particle tracing uses the existing admitted stochastic / statistical parity contract; the roles are registered separately and never merged
rng_stream_roles.other_streams: NOT_APPLICABLE: the harness's random.Random only generates input cases (the framework's seeded propagate_mc is out of scope)
rng_stream_roles.migration_parity_dataset: seeds and the generated case file stay exactly reproducible (immutable)

campaign_seeds.development_rule: development comparisons use development_master_seed (and the registered deterministic cases) only and are never scored or reported as a verdict; every execution with scoring_master_seed is appended to campaign_history and the report is committed whatever its verdict

list.name: value_structure
list.definition: returned value as JSON (complex as [re, im], tuples as lists): keys and order, lengths, strings, booleans, nulls, integers and the int / float type of every number equal

list.name: value_floats
list.tolerance: |rust - py| <= 4 ulp(py) OR <= 1e-12 * max(1, |py|); NaN equals NaN

list.name: error_message
list.definition: str(exception) character for character for TouchstoneError, FrameworkError, CalibrationSolveError, RecordError, PMainsNotPBusError, ZeroDivisionError and ValueError; class only for KeyError and TypeError

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, booleans, error classes / messages, schema shape: equal
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: k_ulp = 4, r_rel = 1e-12 (template proposal); the complex operations are ported with CPython 3.11's formulas so bit-identical results are expected, except where libm pow results reach the ULP bound

exact_invariants.statement: determinism: every Rust call evaluated in two separate processes gives byte-identical output
p_bus_from_generator_input never returns (always PMainsNotPBusError) in both
ladder_abcd of an empty element list is the identity ((1, 0), (0, 0), (0, 0), (1, 0)) in both

conservation_checks.applicable: true (passive-network identities, evaluated where the reference returns)

checks.statement: reciprocity of a ladder: det(ABCD) = A D - B C = 1 for every R4 result
power balance of a matched two-port: dissipated_fraction_matched + |S11|^2 + |S21|^2 = 1 when the fraction is not clipped
SOL round trip: correcting the measured value of every R2 standard with the returned terms reproduces gamma_actual within the reported residual for exactly determined (3-standard, noise-free) cases

impedance-map gate (abep_subsystems::pow.rule: without a registered measured P2 impedance map point the matched-RF-chain transfer is NOT_EVALUATED with reason TBD_AFTER_IMPEDANCE_MAP (A9.2 binding status; SC-WP-05 determining_evidence_gates); with a registered point (two-port ABCD of the characterized match state, measured load impedance, evidence class 'measured') it returns transfer_efficiency of that point; no default network, impedance or efficiency exists
impedance-map gate (abep_subsystems::pow.tests: absent map -> NOT_EVALUATED; a synthetic point -> the transfer_efficiency value; a non-measured evidence class -> INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE

domain_and_error_parity.mapping_rule: every Python exception class maps to exactly one Rust class name; no Rust path may return a value where Python fails, or fail where Python returns

schemas: docs/experiments/hall_icp/p2_impedance_map/p2_impedance_map_schema_v1.json (context; map storage is out of scope)
rules: parsed Touchstone record and SOL record field names, order and types identical

references: tests/test_p2_impedance_framework.py patterns re-expressed as registered cases
golden_and_reference_cases.rule: references are read as committed; they are never regenerated to make Rust pass (RM-R11)

captured_reference_outputs.purpose: lets CI check Rust against the Python reference after Python is retired from active execution

performance_measurement.status: reported, not a decision criterion (A9.24 items 1 and 6)
performance_measurement.statistic: median wall-clock per implementation in one session on one machine

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every call meets its tolerance class
decision_rules.conservation_required: true: CONS-C1..C3 on every Rust result where they apply
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED (= PARITY_PASS) iff every call, INV-C01..C03 and CONS-C1..C3 pass and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; otherwise NOT_ADMITTED (PARITY_FAIL)
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for the listed RF-network kernels (Touchstone ingestion, SOL correction, ladder / two-port relations, V/I power and impedance, the P_mains refusal) within the registered domain; it is NOT physics validation; RF ratings stay TBD_AFTER_IMPEDANCE_MAP and no impedance is predicted
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: restricted to the retained RF-network kernels (RM-R20)

bid_boundary.statement: post-bid-freeze work; no output may be cited by the bid package unless the owner re-freezes

what_this_is_not: not physics validation and not an impedance prediction: every network, impedance and reading is a caller input
not an RF component rating (RF_COMPONENT_RATINGS stays TBD_AFTER_IMPEDANCE_MAP)
not a promotion of any provisional input (RM-R27)
